description: Quiz media (image, audio, or video on a question prompt, title/instructions block, or section description), step 1 of 3 (prepare → upload → finalize) against a Native Forms assessment. Idempotently reserves the asset under the idempotency key and mints a short-lived path-scoped upload grant (single signed PUT, or TUS resumable via the same token). Ceilings: 5 MiB image, 32 MiB audio, 256 MiB video; kind must match the MIME family. Replaying the key returns READY once the upload was finalized. The grant is a transit secret: never log or persist it. Reference the returned asset id from the question doc as an "image", "audio", or "video" node.

idempotencyKey.description: Durable-receipt idempotency key: 8-128 characters of letters, digits, dot, underscore, dash, or colon. Same key + same payload replays the stored receipt; same key + changed payload is a 409.
